title: 第6章 药池名额
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
摸底测试的结果在当天下午就贴了出来。

    教学楼一楼大厅的公告栏前围满了人，三层外三层的，比菜市场还热闹。

    苏念念拽着安槐的袖子，凭借一米六出头的身板，像条泥鳅一样在人群里左钻右钻，硬是挤到了最前面。

    安槐被她拽得踉跄了一下，长腿跟着迈了进去，他身高在这里是优势也是劣势，优势是站在后排也能看清，劣势是被苏念念拽着往前挤的时候，撞了好几个人的肩膀。

    “不好意思，借过。”安槐一路道歉，温和得像个行走的礼仪教科书。

    “让一让让一让！”苏念念完全没有这个觉悟，直接用肩膀开路。

    到了公告栏前，苏念念仰头从最上面看起。

    综合排名第一。

    安槐。

    文化课笔试第一，武道实战评估第一，总分遥遥领先。

    苏念念的目光继续往下扫。

    综合排名第七。

    苏念念。

    文化课中等偏上，武道实战评估第三，综合下来排在第七。

    “第七，还行。”苏念念自己点了点头，随即扭头仰望身后的安槐，拿手指戳他胸口，“你怎么又是第一？你能不能给别人留点面子？”

    安槐认真想了一下。

    “下次我可以故意错两题。”

    “那不叫留面子，那叫侮辱人。”苏念念翻了个白眼。

    旁边有几个学生听到他们的对话，齐齐看过来。

    “第一名就在这儿？”

    “就是那个银灰色头发的？看着好斯文啊。”

    “文化课和武道都是第一，这也太变态了吧。”

    安槐面带微笑，点头致意。

    苏念念叉着腰站在他旁边，一脸与有荣焉的表情，比自己考了第一还得意。

    【检测到大范围情绪波动。按类型排列：震惊31%、羡慕25%、嫉妒19%、佩服15%、其他10%。其中“苏念念”的情绪单独列出：骄傲82%、嘴硬18%。宿主你这个老大，就差把“我小弟天下第一”写在脸上了。】

    安槐没理系统，他的注意力被榜单上另外几个名字吸引了。

    沈晨，综合排名第五，武道实战第四，文化课中上，中规中矩的好学生。

    林落雪，综合排名第十二，文化课排名靠前，武道实战排名中等偏下。

    这个排名很有意思。

    安槐记得系统检测过林落雪的实际修为至少淬体三重，但她在实战评估中的表现，明显是按二重的水准打的。

    刻意藏拙，排名不高不低，既不会引人注目，也不会显得太差。
content_en:
The results of the bottom-up test were posted that afternoon.

The bulletin board in the lobby on the first floor of the teaching building was crowded with people. The third floor and the third floor were busier than the vegetable market.

Su Niannian tugged on An Huai's sleeve, and with her body of just over 1.6 meters tall, she slithered through the crowd like a loach, forcing her way to the front.

An Huai staggered as she pulled him forward, and stepped in with his long legs. His height was both an advantage and a disadvantage here. The advantage was that he could see clearly from the back row. The disadvantage was that when Su Niannian pushed forward, he bumped into the shoulders of several people.

"Sorry, I borrowed it." An Huai apologized all the way, as gentle as a walking etiquette textbook.

"Make way, make way!" Su Niannian had no idea at all and just used her shoulders to clear the way.

When she arrived in front of the bulletin board, Su Niannian raised her head and looked from the top.

Overall ranking first.

Anhuai.

He ranked first in the cultural class written examination, ranked first in the martial arts practical evaluation, and was far ahead in the overall score.

Su Niannian's eyes continued to glance downward.

Ranked seventh overall.

Su Niannian.

The cultural class was above average, the martial arts practical evaluation was third, and overall, he was ranked seventh.

"Seventh, not bad." Su Niannian nodded, then turned to look up at An Huai behind her, poking his chest with her finger, "Why are you number one again? Can you save some face for others?"

An Huai thought carefully.

"Next time I can deliberately get two questions wrong."

"That's not saving face, that's insulting." Su Niannian rolled her eyes.

Several students nearby heard their conversation and looked over.

"Is the first place right here?"

"Is that the one with silver-grey hair? He looks so elegant."

"I am ranked number one in cultural classes and martial arts. This is too perverted."

An Huai smiled and nodded.

Su Niannian stood next to him with her hands on her hips, a proud expression on her face, and she was even prouder than herself for getting the first place in the exam.

[Wide range of mood swings detected.Arranged by type: shocked 31%, envy 25%, jealousy 19%, admiration 15%, other 10%.Among them, the emotions of "Su Niannian" are listed separately: 82% proud and 18% tough-tongued.Host, you are the boss, you just have to write "My little brother is the best in the world" on your face.】

An Huai ignored the system. His attention was attracted by several other names on the list.

Shen Chen, ranked fifth overall, fourth in martial arts practice, above average in cultural classes, a good student with good standards.

Lin Luoxue, ranked twelfth overall, ranked high in cultural subjects, and ranked below average in martial arts practice.

This ranking is very interesting.

An Huai remembered that the system had tested that Lin Luoxue's actual cultivation level was at least the third level of body tempering, but her performance in the actual combat evaluation was obviously at the level of the second level.

Deliberately hiding clumsiness, ranking neither high nor low, neither eye-catching nor too bad.
